PDF.js 5.7.0 (build 37919f5), Mozilla Foundation and contributors.
Vendored from the PDF.js distribution bundled in Zotero on this development machine.
The renderer includes Zotero extensions; Noctua uses the standard PDF.js APIs.
See LICENSE and the licenses in web/cmaps, web/standard_fonts, web/wasm, and web/iccs.
These files are bundled into Noctua; Zotero is not required at runtime.

Noctua modification: CanvasGraphics.beginDrawing accepts ctx.noctuaTheme
for per-canvas use of the bundled Zotero color renderer.

Noctua modification: PDFPageProxy.getTextContent consumes text streams through
getReader() so PDF indexing works in WebKit without ReadableStream async iteration.
